rubric: The count matches the request (default 10, 20 for vocabulary); one fact per card; fronts never contain their own answer; no duplicate facts.
Backs are short and exact (1 to 15 words, numbers with units, dates with years); vocabulary cards carry the article or gender and an example sentence.
A quiz mixes types (short answer, multiple choice with plausible wrong options, one-sentence explain) with answers and one-line reasons at the end.
Turn-by-turn mode asks one question only, then stops; on an answer it grades, explains, gives the score and the next question.
The paste format line ('front ; back', one per line) is present; facts beyond the source are marked as general knowledge.
